Sep-25Correlation between gas price and tariff
BGRIM’s electricity tariff for IU is normally benchmarked with PEA (base tariff+Ft ) which generally moves in the same direction with gas price.Ft (Fuel  Adjustment  Charge)  is a component  of electricity  market  tariff, announced  by Energy  Regulatory  Commission  (ERC)  every  4 months  to reflect  EGAT’s  overall
